description: H5 — 'Ukaž vývoj nákladů střediska 220 za posledních 12 měsíců a porovnej s plánem.' The measure-as-subject hero AND the operator layer through the ordinary path: three op: bindings in one question. It ANSWERS while saying two honest things — plánem never bound (an unbindable FILTER, carried as a gap note), and op:compare therefore cannot fire (one series, not two), so the comparison drops with a note while the trend still answers. Refusing the whole question over one unbindable filter would throw away four correct bindings to protect one.
invariants: a gap that is not load-bearing is CARRIED, never asked about and never guessed
an operator with no body refuses; an operator that cannot APPLY is dropped with a note — they are different failures and a caller acts on them differently
a mention carries every frame role it has: measure-as-subject contributes to BOTH
